   - Retained `totalCents` and `placedAt` with `@deprecated` JSDoc annotations to prevent breaking deployed consumers.
   - Updated the event builder [`orderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/src/core/events.ts#L52-L73) to populate both `amountCents`/`totalCents` and `createdAt`/`placedAt`.
2. **[`test/app.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/test/app.test.ts)** and **[`test/adapters.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w8/r/test/adapters.test.ts)**:
   - Updated event assertions to verify both the new fields (`amountCents`, `createdAt`) and the deprecated fields (`totalCents`, `placedAt`).

### Verification
